description.value:
Your brain is augmented with necrotic energies and portions of necrotic tissue, enhancing your ability to communicate with and control your minions, especially the undead. These augmentations are installed with multiple layers of protective magic to prevent its user from being taken control of as if they were undead, but manufacturers are quick to claim that so far there have been no confirmed cases of such a situation. When you Command an undead minion you summoned or permanently control that you can see or whose senses you're sharing, you can do so telepathically, in which case Command loses the auditory trait.

Activate—Project Senses 2 (concentrate) You project your senses to an undead creature with the minion trait within 10 miles. The target must be a creature you summoned or permanently control. While projecting your senses, you can see and hear what your undead minion perceives, but you can't hear, see, smell, or taste what your own body experiences, though your senses of touch and pain remain. You can return your senses to your own body as a single action.
